methodology: Rankings are compiled from publicly reported marketplace data: TikTok Shop US category GMV and creator-commerce reports, Amazon category best-seller rank movements, Temu editorial best-seller roundups, and AliExpress order-velocity feeds. Unit and revenue figures are the most recent published values, not live API pulls. Price bands and category shares are OZ estimates derived from those same public reports and are marked as such.

items.name: Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
items.note: Satisfying cleaning demos are the single highest-converting video format on the platform. Motor and battery grade are the two things buyers get wrong.

items.name: Portable Air Pump & Camping Light
items.note: Four functions in one 145g shell: inflate, deflate, camp light, power bank. Multi-function is what carries the margin.

items.name: Mini Waffle Maker
items.note: Sub-$15 price point plus giftable box equals impulse volume. Non-stick coating certification is the usual failure point in QC.

items.name: Stainless Steel Garlic Press
items.note: A five-second demo sells it with no narration. Classic Yiwu low-ticket, high-velocity play.

items.name: Vegetable Chopper & Slicer
items.note: Blade sharpness retention and dishwasher-safe claims drive both reviews and returns. Ask for the blade steel spec.

items.name: LED Shower Light (IP65, RGB)
items.note: Rides the low-light wellness trend. Waterproof rating must be tested, not just claimed on the listing.

items.name: Car Door Storage Organiser
items.note: Category number one within a week of launch. PU leather grade and stitch quality separate the winners from the refund wave.

items.name: Bamboo Cooling Bed Sheets
items.note: "Cooling" is the top bedding search term of the year. Bamboo origin and weave density are the two specs buyers actually compare.

items.name: Electric Kettle (plastic-free interior)
items.note: The "no plastic inside" claim is the whole pitch in Western markets. It has to hold up in a teardown.

items.name: Raised Garden Planter with Legs
items.note: Urban balconies and no-bend gardening for older buyers. Freight is the margin killer here — volume per unit matters more than unit cost.

items.name: Mini Cordless Chainsaw
items.note: Viral on video, but battery certification and blade guard compliance are strict in the EU. Budget for the paperwork.

items.name: Rechargeable Hand Warmer
items.note: October is the last full test month before Black Friday. Sells on comfort now, as a stocking filler in December.
